design.hypothesis: Public reference reconstruction error identifies composition error in daily taxi totals
design.parent: Existing airport intercept/count-deficit Huber20 source calibration
design.change: One additional reference-error coefficient per airport, same Huber20/ridge0.001
design.reference_error: Leave-one-source-day-out stand-composition reference prediction minus published reference mean
design.reference_fit: Unchanged cached two-month public-only inverse, ridge(10/300)^2; exact PRESS deletion
design.interpretation: Reference times and taxi times share a source cohort; test conditional bias, not independent second evidence
design.evaluation: Leave one calendar month out inside each original outer permitted training window
design.departure_labels: Only each outer allowed training months enter calibration or source-error evaluation
design.gate: Both outer windows improve source mean-error RMSE at least5%, with paired-month bootstrap upper bound below zero
design.caveats: Source reconstruction is transductive but public-only; common source does not prove cohort identity; source gain is not taxi CV
